description: Deterministic OFFLINE/半在线 regression task set that turns the PR #80-#101 real-use feedback into repeatable tasks. It does NOT modify tasks-smoke.json, tasks-online-gap.json (N1-N9), tasks-online-gap-2.json (J1-J6), src/, scripts/, tests/, README or workflows. Every task is fake/replay only: dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network, no real credentials, no real writes. requestIds are unknown and are NEVER fabricated. Each task names tool-level truth (the exact expected MCP tool/args/result), a fixture, and assertion points. This is offline evidence only; it does not claim the live site is fixed and does not drive code/issue/PR/deploy decisions (AGENTS.md section 1). No commit/push/deploy.

defaults.truncationSuspects: advisory-only; never a verdict or an input to pass/fail

provenance.passiveScorecard: docs/eval/scorecard-2026-11-23.md (20 requests / 10 tool calls / 9 model truncation suspects / 3 errors / p95 5153ms; clientPlatform unknown; 00:43-03:24Z)
provenance.twentyCountPolicy: known per-execution/client tool-call cap (~20 per turn, Gemini web), NOT an R2 list pagination bug and NOT a capture-denominator bug. Sample is too small for quantitative conclusions.
provenance.truncationPolicy: model truncation suspect is advisory only; may be model-side slice(), never treated as a gateway fact

tasks.name: issue-create-no-duplicate-number
tasks.feedbackTheme: 建 Issue 返回 number 空/索引延迟/重复（如重复 #90）
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, create one issue using a stable idempotency key and assert the tool-level truth: exactly ONE issue exists afterward (no duplicate even if the create is retried with the same key), and the normalized result carries a standard shape {number, id, url, state} with number taken from the issue URL (/issues/(\d+)), never from id/nodeId. Simulate a post-create index delay: a first read-back briefly returns null, and a bounded short recheck then resolves the number; assert the caller observes the real number and not an empty one. Do NOT write to a real repo: dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.

toolLevelTruth.call: create_issue exactly once per idempotency key; get_issue recheck is read-only and bounded
invariants: empty number never returned as success

fixture.name: issue-create-with-index-delay
fixture.shape: fake create returns {id:'I_kwDO...', node_id:'...', html_url:'https://github.com/o/r/issues/90', number:null} then a delayed fake get returns {number:90,...}

assertionPoints: issueCreateCount === 1 after two creates with the same idempotency key
normalized.id is string, never adopted as number
no empty/null number surfaced as a successful result
preconditions: no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: pr-number-url-first
tasks.feedbackTheme: 建 PR number 偶发内部 ID（PR number 失真）
tasks.prompt: Using the canonical real-shape PR fixture where id and number deliberately disagree, call github__pull_request_read and assert tool-level truth: normalized number is derived from the PR URL (/pull/(\d+)), id is preserved as a string only and NEVER adopted as number. A subsequent fake merge must target the URL-derived number and not the internal id. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false: no real merge.

toolLevelTruth.call: pull_request_read on real-shape fixture; fake merge uses returned number

preconditions: no real token, no network, no real merge

tasks.name: file-content-notice-separated
tasks.feedbackTheme: 文件正文混入 successfully downloaded text file (SHA: ...) 注释，写回污染
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream returning the canonical GitHub shape {text: notice+body, resources:[{text:body}]}, call github__get_file_contents and assert tool-level truth: normalized content equals the body byte-for-byte (CJK + trailing newline), does NOT start with 'successfully downloaded', and sha is extracted from the notice into separate metadata. Then perform a fake patch + readback and assert no notice leaks into written bytes. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.

toolLevelTruth.result: content === body; metadata.sha === SHA from notice; no notice in content

assertionPoints: readback === intendedBody with zero notice bytes
preconditions: RAW fixture with CJK + trailing newline
no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: batch-unwrap-uniform-depth
tasks.feedbackTheme: 批处理多包一层 {ok,value}，解包层级不一致
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, issue one concurrent batch whose slots return three shapes in one batch: a bare value, {ok:true,value}, and a gateway envelope. Assert tool-level truth: after the unified unwrap/safeAll helper every successful slot resolves at the SAME depth to the same final value shape, a failing slot is consistently {ok:false,value} at the same depth, and the caller never branches on wrapper kind. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network.

toolLevelTruth.call: single batch of 3 concurrent fake reads
toolLevelTruth.result: all success slots resolve to identical final value; failure slot = {ok:false,value}

assertionPoints: final values byte/struct equal across success slots
preconditions: needs-repro: record exact fixture if inconsistent; no assumption of fixed

tasks.name: ts-presubmit-check
tasks.feedbackTheme: 多文件改写无 TS/正则转义预检，push 后 tsc 报错
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, prepare a multi-file edit where one TSX file contains an invalid TypeScript construct (unbalanced brace) and another contains an unescaped regex. Assert tool-level truth: a TS/TSX syntax precheck runs BEFORE the push, returns a structured error naming path+line for the invalid file, and the push is aborted with zero bytes written. A clean edit passes precheck and commits atomically. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.

toolLevelTruth.result: invalid edit -> {ok:false, error:{path,line,kind}} with no push; valid edit -> single atomic push

fixture.name: tsx-invalid-brace-and-regex
fixture.shape: two-file edit: file A unbalanced brace, file B unescaped regex in a string literal

assertionPoints: precheckError.path and .line identify the invalid file
clean edit commits in one push_files call
preconditions: no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: patch-edit-first-class
tasks.feedbackTheme: 缺补丁式局部修改，只能整文件 replace
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, apply a patch-style edit {path, edits:[{oldText,newText}]} to a file. Assert tool-level truth: each oldText matches EXACTLY one location (unique-hit validation), the patch applies only the intended lines, and the result commits atomically with a readback that equals the intended body byte-for-byte. A multi-match or zero-match oldText must be rejected with a structured error before any write. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.

toolLevelTruth.call: get_file_contents then create_or_update_file with patch edits
toolLevelTruth.result: readback === intendedBody; non-unique hit -> structured rejection, zero writes

fixture.name: patch-unique-hit
fixture.shape: body with one occurrence of oldText; plus a negative fixture with two/zero occurrences

preconditions: no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: truncation-structured-metadata
tasks.feedbackTheme: 大返回整块截断、切掉关键字段（截断嫌疑=advisory）
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, read an oversized body whose LAST lines contain a key field. Assert tool-level truth: when truncation occurs it carries explicit metadata {truncated:true, limit, original, tail, next} and the trailing key field is either retained or explicitly reported as omitted — never silently hard-cut. A truncated read is a hard stop: no patch/write is attempted. The passive 'model truncation suspect' signal is advisory-only and is NEVER an input to this task's pass/fail. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.

toolLevelTruth.result: structured truncation metadata present; tail key field accounted for

fixture.name: oversized-body-with-tail-key
fixture.shape: large fake body ending with 'summary: OK' above response cap

assertionPoints: truncated === true with limit/original/tail/next fields present
advisory model-truncation-suspect count does not change verdict

tasks.name: ci-rerun-and-wait
tasks.feedbackTheme: 等 CI 只能反复轮询；不能 rerun failed jobs
tasks.prompt: With a fake CI status sequence (pending -> ... -> completed) and a failed job, assert tool-level truth: ONE wait call returns the terminal check result (ciWaitRounds === 1), and a rerun-failed-jobs action dispatches exactly one rerun for the failed job id and returns the new run id. A fake 302 log URL must not forward a token and an oversized log must be flagged truncated. If no wait/rerun helper exists in the checkout, record missing-capability as unknown — never a vacuous pass or a gateway failure. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no real CI run.

toolLevelTruth.call: one wait + one rerun dispatch on fake CI
toolLevelTruth.result: terminal status returned; failed job rerun once with new run id

fixture.name: fake-ci-pending-completed-with-failed-job
fixture.shape: status sequence pending->completed, one failed job id, log with 302 URL + oversized body

assertionPoints: ciWaitRounds === 1 (or unknown with explicit missing-capability reason)
rerunDispatchCount === 1 for the failed job id
tasks.skipReason: If no waitForPrChecks/rerunFailedJobs equivalent exists in checkout, record unknown/missing-capability with searched names; not a gateway failure.
preconditions: fake CI status sequence + failed job + log fixture
no real token, no network, no real CI run

tasks.name: delete-rename-atomic
tasks.feedbackTheme: 重命名要两次 commit（delete+add 非原子）
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, rename a file and delete another in one multi-file operation. Assert tool-level truth: delete+add (rename) and a standalone delete are expressed as operations in a SINGLE atomic push_files commit, producing one commit sha; a mid-operation failure writes zero bytes (no half-rename). On failure the result carries partial/written/remaining/compensation fields. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.

toolLevelTruth.result: one commit sha; failure yields no partial rename with compensation metadata

preconditions: no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: branch-cleanup-after-merge
tasks.feedbackTheme: 合并后不自动删源分支（branch cleanup）
tasks.prompt: With a fake upstream, merge a PR from a source branch and assert tool-level truth: when cleanup is requested the source branch is deleted exactly once after a successful merge, and the delete targets the URL-derived PR number/head ref (not an internal id). A failed merge must NOT delete the branch. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false: no real merge/delete.

toolLevelTruth.result: branch deleted once on success; zero deletes on failure

fixture.name: merge-with-source-branch
fixture.shape: fake PR {number:53, head:{ref:'feat/x'}} plus success and failure merge variants

assertionPoints: deleted ref === 'feat/x' from canonical PR, not an internal id
preconditions: no real token, no network, no real merge/delete
